_comment: Third-party tools shipped beside courseforge-pdf.exe. They are not built by
any script here: a maintainer downloads each one from its publisher and copies
the unpacked folder into dist\courseforge-pdf\. Build-PdfFixer.ps1 refuses to
package a tree whose files do not match these SHA-256 digests, so a swapped or
tampered binary cannot ride into the installer unnoticed.
The digests below were taken from the copies that shipped in 1.1.8. Before
trusting them as PROVENANCE (not just consistency), one person should download
each package fresh from the source URL and confirm the listed file hashes match.
